name: freyja4
description: Freyja 4 — Mardöll, the anti-slop surface engine. Picks a macrostructure before it picks a look, dresses it in one of twenty OKLCH themes (or a constructed custom palette), rotates structure across runs so two pages for two briefs are not colour-swaps of one template, and refuses the on-distribution defaults every model was trained into. Ships four verbs (build / audit / redesign / study), 21 macrostructures, 50 component archetypes, 4 genres, a 58-gate slop test, and a dependency-free deterministic gate runtime that judges the emitted HTML/CSS instead of trusting the model's self-report. Node >= 18 for verification.
